result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and paved sidewalks on all corners, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway width and lack of physical traffic calming measures or refuge islands increase the exposure time for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to provide clear crossing intervals and countdowns.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the corners to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signal heads that show the remaining time to cross, improving pedestrian decision-making and safety.

result.summary: The street is a residential corridor with sidewalks and a high-visibility zebra crosswalk. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical protection or daylighting at the crossing increase pedestrian exposure and risk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway, including parking and bike lanes, increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the entire street width

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles right up to the crosswalk edge block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right curbsides adjacent to the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center painted buffer to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and sidewalks, but lacks active traffic control such as signals or stop signs for the primary roadway. Pedestrian safety is compromised by parked vehicles obstructing sightlines and utility poles placed within the walking path.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled crossing
hazards.description: No visible stop signs or traffic signals are present to regulate vehicle flow at this marked crossing.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent parking in the sightline zones.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or a raised intersection to reduce vehicle speeds at the crossing point.
